hypotheses.label: guarded_alliance
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: The source pole forms a he-combination under a coiled-spirit marker while the life-gate presses against its own palace; the display pole is fed by its environment but keeps its nourishing star in tomb. Read together: the brand's core idea is a deliberate pact that stays guarded about its generosity.
limiting: interpretation is structural; no factual prediction is made
the he-combination's traditional gloss is register-level, not outcome-level
hypotheses.decision_guard: State as tradition-conditional direction only. Do not phrase as a promise about market response (law 22).
hypotheses.scope: primary axis {1,4} plus centre 5 lodging edge
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the brand's public voice remains narrower than its internal generosity
hypotheses.validation_path: re-check against the Assignment-1 insight list: if a researched insight already claims 'generous' positioning, this claim is CONTRADICTS_KNOWN and must be reworked
limitations: interpretation is structural; no factual prediction is made
the he-combination's traditional gloss is register-level, not outcome-level

competing_candidates.label: quiet_craft_discipline
competing_candidates.why: 九地 + star-in-tomb support a quiet craft reading; it is not displaced by the pact evidence

competing_candidates.label: corrective_awakening
competing_candidates.why: requires an authority-rise or turnaround pattern on the spine; 青龙耀明/青龙转光 sit in palaces 7 and 9, outside the ranked scope, and no spine atom carries a turn

hypotheses.label: precise_watchful
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: Coiled spirit and life-gate sit under gate pressure at the source pole; depth and display sit together at the display pole with the centre's stem lodged into it. The voice register is exact and observant, warm only where the structure allows it.
limiting: tone register is the least fact-bound layer of the board; treat as creative direction
hypotheses.decision_guard: Voice adjectives must trace to a deity/gate/star atom in the shipped package, never to mood (no free invention).
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds where the brand speaks about its process rather than its effect
hypotheses.validation_path: one line of voice copy drafted against C002; if the line promises an outcome, the line fails the guard, not the claim
limitations: tone register is the least fact-bound layer of the board; treat as creative direction

competing_candidates.label: warm_directive
competing_candidates.why: supported by 宫生门 at the display pole; would need the life-gate to be unopposed, which it is not

competing_candidates.label: cool_withholding
competing_candidates.why: supported by 九地 and star-in-tomb; distinguished from this claim only by degree of warmth

hypotheses.label: ritual_mark
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: Display gate with a deep-earth deity, a union combination, and a stored core: the name and mark should behave like a made object used in a repeated act, not like an announcement of authority.
limiting: no literal object, place, or figure may be read off the chart (laws 23-24)
hypotheses.decision_guard: A name or mark must never be 'selected by the chart'. The chart supplies register and constraint only; the choice traces to Assignment-1 (see C013, rejected).
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the mark is used in a repeated act rather than as a burst of signalling
hypotheses.validation_path: logo direction must name 2-3 mood-board styles and one explicit avoid-line (brief requirement), each traced to Assignment 1
limitations: no literal object, place, or figure may be read off the chart (laws 23-24)

competing_candidates.label: visible_authority
competing_candidates.why: explicitly supported outside the spine (palaces 3 and 7); legal contrast, not ranked

competing_candidates.label: engineered_softness
competing_candidates.why: no spine atom supports softening; tomb, punishment and pressure markers all point the other way

hypotheses.label: sustained_care
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: The life-gate stands at the source pole, the display pole carries the slow-earth star and keeps it in tomb, and the centre's stem is lodged into that same display palace. Structurally the product behaves as something kept and applied over time.
limiting: product category is supplied by the case as scope only; the chart never names a product
hypotheses.decision_guard: No medical, therapeutic or bodily claim may be derived (law 23). The star is used strictly as a registry term for a slow earth process.
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the product's value is expressed in repeated use rather than in a single effect
hypotheses.validation_path: product definition (format, variants, size, price) is NOT chart-derivable: those rows carry NO_CHART_SUPPORT and must come from Assignment 1
limitations: product category is supplied by the case as scope only; the chart never names a product

competing_candidates.label: contained_remedy
competing_candidates.why: supported by the star-in-tomb and the punishment marker: a small, concentrated format reading is legal

competing_candidates.label: restorative_rebuild
competing_candidates.why: requires a turnaround or authority-rise pattern inside the spine; none is present

hypotheses.label: layered_reveal
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: A concealing earth deity holds a display gate; the environment feeds that gate; the nourishing core is stored; the hidden brightness sits inside the same palace. The package should be composed in two states — a muted closed state and a warmer opened state.
limiting: the chart cannot specify colour; colour must come from the mood board and Assignment-1 insight
hypotheses.decision_guard: Material statements are creative direction only. No physical fact (substrate, finish, mechanism) may be asserted from the chart (laws 23-24).
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the first read is quiet and the second read rewards attention
hypotheses.validation_path: shelf-standout element must be describable in one sentence from three feet away (brief requirement); tie it to one mood-board pin
limitations: the chart cannot specify colour; colour must come from the mood board and Assignment-1 insight

competing_candidates.label: muted_shell_over_active_core
competing_candidates.why: supported by 九地 + star-in-tomb; differs from this claim only in whether the reveal is staged or simultaneous

competing_candidates.label: overt_signal_low_noise
competing_candidates.why: contradicted by the concealing deity and the stored star

hypotheses.label: opposition_led
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: The two poles are a generative pair (water feeds wood) but their local conditions invert: agency presses on the environment at the source pole while the environment feeds agency at the display pole. The difference to lead with is that inversion, not a feature list.
limiting: pillar-register relations are tallied separately and never absorbed into the spine count
hypotheses.decision_guard: The difference must be stated as a describable direction, never as 'better' (brief requirement).
hypotheses.scope: primary axis {1,4} with the day-branch chong noted from the pillar register
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the category leads with performance claims that push against the environment
hypotheses.validation_path: place the package beside the 3-5 researched competitors and state the inversion in one sentence
limitations: pillar-register relations are tallied separately and never absorbed into the spine count

competing_candidates.label: layer_led
competing_candidates.why: supported by 九地 + star-in-tomb; a legal second direction for Brief 2

competing_candidates.label: sequence_led
competing_candidates.why: sequencing is another archetype's jurisdiction (ARC-11) and would double-count one structure across two briefs

hypotheses.label: pressure_into_poise
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: A pressed gate at the source pole, a fed gate at the display pole, a generative opposition between them, and a stored core in the display palace: the campaign idea is pressure resolved into composure.
limiting: no calendar or venue claim is made anywhere in this campaign direction
hypotheses.decision_guard: The big idea must not promise an outcome or a result (law 22).
hypotheses.scope: primary axis {1,4} plus centre lodging and the visible command-axis contrast
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the campaign shows the act rather than the result
hypotheses.validation_path: hero image briefed from C008 and stage from C009 must both be derivable from this idea without a fourth, unrelated claim
limitations: no calendar or venue claim is made anywhere in this campaign direction

competing_candidates.label: return_to_the_source
competing_candidates.why: the generative axis supports a return-to-source idea; distinguished from this claim by direction of travel

competing_candidates.label: the_quiet_instrument
competing_candidates.why: supported by star-in-tomb + punishment; a legal third direction

hypotheses.label: single_subject_soft_light
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: A display gate under a concealing earth deity, with the slow-earth star in tomb: one subject, low and even light, focal weight on what is withheld rather than on what is displayed.
limiting: no claims about the photographed person, body, or condition (law 23)
hypotheses.decision_guard: Composition language is creative direction. Nothing in this claim describes the world.
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the hero image is readable at thumbnail scale without any text
hypotheses.validation_path: generate or shoot two frames (single subject; object-only) and test which one survives the 'no text' rule
limitations: no claims about the photographed person, body, or condition (law 23)

competing_candidates.label: object_only_ritual_frame
competing_candidates.why: strongly supported by star-in-tomb; would remove the human element entirely

competing_candidates.label: figure_in_pressure
competing_candidates.why: supported by the impulse star and gate pressure

hypotheses.label: enclosed_studio
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: Depth deity, display gate fed by its palace, slow-earth star stored: an enclosed, low-ceilinged stage with a directional light source, rather than an open location.
limiting: the chart supplies register, not architecture
hypotheses.decision_guard: Palace direction is contextual only; never state a real location (law 5).
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the set can be built in one controlled space with one motivated light
hypotheses.validation_path: location scouting brief or AI prompt must contain: enclosure, single motivated light, one reserved negative space
limitations: the chart supplies register, not architecture

competing_candidates.label: threshold_interior
competing_candidates.why: an interior edge (door, sill, counter) is equally supported and keeps the 'act' visible

competing_candidates.label: open_field
competing_candidates.why: contradicted by the concealing deity, the stored star, and the slow-earth star

hypotheses.label: hands_only
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: The concealing deity and stored star put the human register behind the object register; the impulse star keeps movement in frame. Hands and gesture carry the act without a face.
limiting: audience fit is a case-side judgement; the chart cannot confirm it
hypotheses.decision_guard: No inference about any person, body, or condition is permitted; casting here is a stated creative choice (law 23).
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the campaign can be cast from hands and gesture alone
hypotheses.validation_path: state the choice explicitly in the brief as a deliberate avoidance of faces, and give the reason
limitations: audience fit is a case-side judgement; the chart cannot confirm it

competing_candidates.label: product_only
competing_candidates.why: legal and supported by star-in-tomb; removes all human presence

competing_candidates.label: one_calm_figure
competing_candidates.why: legal if the figure's stillness is motivated by the stored core

hypotheses.label: core_first_then_context
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: The display pole holds the gestating and growing phases while the source pole holds peak-then-cut phases. Build the supported, growing assets first; add the pressed life-register assets afterwards as the closing beat.
limiting: the chart's own time units are not a delivery schedule
hypotheses.decision_guard: Sequence claims cite phase atoms, not preference.
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while the production run can hold the pressed-register assets to the end
hypotheses.validation_path: asset list ordered: hero, then 2-3 supporting, then detail, then any motion — with the phase citation beside each block
limitations: the chart's own time units are not a delivery schedule

competing_candidates.label: context_first_then_core
competing_candidates.why: the pressed life-gate could set up the display; legal if the story needs a problem first

competing_candidates.label: parallel_build
competing_candidates.why: the phase register is clearly split by pole, so a parallel build would ignore the only sequencing evidence the board offers

hypotheses.label: hybrid_staged
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: The defect points sit on the concealed/instrument layer; the command axis is off the spine and pressed; the display pole is the supported one. Proposal: stage the work in passes with a human gate at the instrument/punishment point, rather than committing a single automated chain.
limiting: the chart cannot select tools or vendors
hypotheses.decision_guard: No budget, vendor, or schedule claim is made; the case states none and none may be inferred.
hypotheses.scope: primary axis {1,4} with the visible command-axis contrast from {8}
hypotheses.scenario_condition: holds while each pass has one named human approval point and a rollback
hypotheses.validation_path: write the pass list with the approval gate marked at the pass that touches the concealed/instrument layer
limitations: the chart cannot select tools or vendors

competing_candidates.label: ai_led_human_gated
competing_candidates.why: supported by 天辅 as 值符; a legal alternative if the team accepts a human gate at the breakage point

competing_candidates.label: human_led_ai_assisted
competing_candidates.why: supported by the punishment marker; more conservative than proposed

hypotheses.label: chart_selected_name
hypotheses.interpretation_basis: Draft claim (retained for the record): the chart's union marker and rise-to-throne markers 'select' a brand name.
limiting: kept in the package deliberately: a rejection that is visible is stronger than a rejection that is silent
hypotheses.decision_guard: Rejected. The chart supplies register and constraint; selection belongs to Assignment-1 evidence.
hypotheses.validation_path: if a name candidate appears, it must be traced to a named insight or pin, then checked against C003's register, never the reverse
limitations: kept in the package deliberately: a rejection that is visible is stronger than a rejection that is silent
